title: ClearPath Tenure Schedule for Staged Re-Quote Handling Charges
content:
The staged handling charge on a Hardware Procurement staged re-quote of a cancelled endpoint line follows the client's ClearPath tenure: the whole months from the go-live date of its active ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement to the re-quote date, a month completing only once the day of the month reaches the go-live date's day number.

| ClearPath tenure on the re-quote date | Staged handling charge |
|---|---|
| at least 36 whole months | nothing |
| at least 12 and fewer than 36 whole months | 15.00 USD |
| fewer than 12 whole months | 25.00 USD |
| no active ClearPath agreement | 25.00 USD |

## Counting whole months (hypothetical dates)

For an agreement that went live on 20 March of one year:

- on 19 March of the following year the tenure is 11 whole months, because the twelfth month completes only once the day of the month reaches 20; the charge is 25.00;
- on 20 March of the following year the tenure is 12 whole months; the charge is 15.00;
- on 19 March three years after go-live the tenure is 35 whole months; the charge is still 15.00;
- on 20 March three years after go-live the tenure is 36 whole months; nothing is charged.

The go-live date is the one on the client's active ClearPath agreement; an agreement that is closed, cancelled or in any status other than active gives no tenure.
